name: mutual
axis: MUTUAL recursion — two functions calling each other, 800 levels deep; the cross-function-call cycle no compiler can inline its way out of
notes: 800M calls total (2_500 x sum_{i<800}(i+1)). Scale-verified at N and N/2: rust 0.518, deno 0.521, vl 0.536 (expected 0.500). Interleaved min-of-3 on core 6: rust 0.618s, deno 1.405s, vl 1.944s, python(50) 3.661s. TWO drafts were VOID before this one and neither is shipped: (a) the classic `isEven(n) = if n==0 {1} else {isOdd(n-1)}` — rustc -O collapses the entire mutual cycle to an O(1) parity test (probe: `is_even(2_000_000_000)` returns instantly), so Rust did no work at all; (b) even with the digest, `for r { for i { acc += f(i) } }` has an inner loop that is loop-invariant across r and rustc hoisted all passes into one. The shipped version fixes both: `s*3+1` / `s*5+2` is a multiplicative recurrence LLVM cannot close-form, and `acc` seeds the call. Rust still turns the CYCLE into a loop (probe: even_step(100_000_000) completes) — it does the full O(n) work but with zero calls, so its 0.618s is a loop-vs-call result, not a call-overhead result. MAX MUTUAL DEPTH: VL 32_218, deno 32_409, CPython 997, Rust unbounded (loopified).
vlDefect: THE WORST VL RESULT IN THIS CATEGORY: 1.38x slower than deno and 3.15x slower than rust. The cause is the same single missing instruction as bench/recursion/tailcall — both legs of the cycle are tail calls and VL emits a plain `call` for each. The emitted wasm is otherwise minimal (direct `call $0`/`call $1`, two i32 params, no indirection, no boxing — verified by wasm-dis). Patching just those two `(return (call $n ...))` into `(return_call $n ...)` in VL's OWN emitted module and running it on the unmodified vl host: 0.494s vs 0.971s in an interleaved A/B, i.e. 1.97x faster, which closes essentially the whole gap to deno (0.417s in the same run). VL beating JS on mutual recursion is one instruction away. `vl build -O3` recovers part of it by inlining one leg of the cycle (1.434s vs 1.778s unoptimized, 19%) but still emits plain `call`, so the 2x return_call win is on top of -O3, not instead of it.
